description: This file defines a set of React components and hooks for a sidebar UI element, including context management, toggle functionality, and various subcomponents like menu items, buttons, headers, and separators. It manages sidebar state, responsiveness for mobile, and keyboard shortcuts.

methods.name: useSidebar
methods.description: Custom React hook to access sidebar context, throws error if used outside provider.

methods.name: SidebarProvider
methods.description: React component that provides sidebar state and context to its children, manages open/close state, responsiveness, and keyboard shortcuts.

methods.name: Sidebar
methods.description: Main sidebar component that renders differently based on mobile state and collapsibility options.

methods.name: SidebarTrigger
methods.description: Button component to toggle the sidebar visibility.

methods.name: SidebarRail
methods.description: Button component for sidebar rail, used for toggling sidebar with visual indicator.

methods.name: SidebarInset
methods.description: Main content area when sidebar is inset.

methods.name: SidebarHeader
methods.description: Component for sidebar header section.

methods.name: SidebarFooter
methods.description: Component for sidebar footer section.

methods.name: SidebarSeparator
methods.description: Visual separator component within sidebar.

methods.name: SidebarContent
methods.description: Container for sidebar main content.

methods.name: SidebarGroup
methods.description: Component for grouping sidebar items.

methods.name: SidebarGroupLabel
methods.description: Label for sidebar groups.

methods.name: SidebarGroupAction
methods.description: Action button within sidebar group.

methods.name: SidebarGroupContent
methods.description: Content container for sidebar groups.

methods.name: SidebarMenu
methods.description: Container for sidebar menu items.

methods.name: SidebarMenuItem
methods.description: Individual menu item in sidebar.

methods.name: sidebarMenuButtonVariants
methods.description: Variant styling configuration for sidebar menu buttons.

methods.name: SidebarMenuButton
methods.description: Button component for sidebar menu items, supports tooltip and active state.

methods.name: SidebarMenuAction
methods.description: Action button for sidebar menu, with hover and show-on-hover behavior.

methods.name: SidebarMenuBadge
methods.description: Badge indicator for sidebar menu items.

methods.name: SidebarMenuSkeleton
methods.description: Skeleton placeholder for loading sidebar menu items.

methods.name: SidebarMenuSub
methods.description: Submenu container within sidebar menu.

methods.name: SidebarMenuSubItem
methods.description: Submenu item in sidebar.

methods.name: SidebarMenuSubButton
methods.description: Button for submenu items, supports active state and asChild rendering.
